content: Jahuen haxenicabo Jesusen tachocai
Pascua fiesta nocorihyamahi bi mai jenebahini Papa qui cati sca jan jai Jesusen honanquin. Jahuen jonibohon shinanxon mahuanoxon caman jatohon shinanquin.
Pascua piti piriyamahiboya cahen Judas, Simon Iscariotenin baque, tiroma yoshiman bihxon tiroma shinan jahuen jointi janin niascaquin, Jesus paranxon bihmanoxahnnon.

Pascua piti pihi tsinquiscacani, Jesus jahuen haxenicabo betan. Mian sca jato jatihibi hihbojahue Papan jai cahen Jesusen honanquin. Jahuen Papa janinhax jonish bi hahquirihbi hahqui cahi cahen honanrihbiquin.
Misa janinhax huenixon sca jahuen tari potahax hani payoman chinexehti.
Bandeja qui jene chicoxon jahuen haxenicabo tachoquin. Tachoxon hahan jan chinexehtai payoman sca jato tasoquin. Jascajaquin jato tachopaquequin.
Simon Pedro qui nocoquihranscai. —¿Hea rihbi min tachocatsihquin, Hihbon? —hahquin Simoman.
—Hen mia tachoca jahua hihcatsihquiquin, rahma honanxonma bi tah min huetsa tian pari honanyaxihqui —hahquin Jesusen.
—Hea tah min jahuentianbi tachotimahi, hihbon —hahscaquin Pedronen. —Hen mia tachóyamahah tah min henama sca jatihi —hahquin Jesusen.
—Hea tachoxon mepanxon manashimarihbihue, Hihbon —hahscaquin Simon Pedronen.
—Nashitanax ta tsoabi nashiti pishinyamascaiqui, tachoquiti huesti pishini, jatihobi rishtama sca hihnoxon. Mato tah man rishtajomaboscai, hihcax bi jatihibima —jato jaquin Jesusen.
Jesus parannoxihqui joni honanxon copi jato jascajaquin, jatihibima jaquin.
Jato tachoquin queyoxon jahuen chopa sahuerihbihax jahuen tsahotinin tsahopaquexon jato yocaquin: —¿Jahua man haxenon hihxon hen mato tachocain? ¿Man honanyamahin?
Hihbon, Honanmanican, hah tah man hea quenaquin jai. Hahcoinquin. Jaa tah hen qui.
Maton hihbo, mato honanmanicah rihbi hihxon bi hean mato tachocaiya tah man maton rihbi joni huetsa tachotihi.
Hen hahcai jisxon man jascajaribinon tah hen mato jismahahqui.
Mato tah hen yohicoinai. Yonoti ta jahuen hapo mentan hashoan tee hihboma qui. Raana joni rihbi ta jaa raanai joni mentan hashoan yohuan hihboma qui.
Nea hen mato yohihi joibo honanxon, hen mato yohihi quescabijahax tah man hahan jenimati jaresscayaxihqui.
Mato jatihibi qui tah hen yohiyamahi. Heen caisaibo tah hen honanai. Papan huishamani joi jai quescabi ta janoxihquiqui. Heen paan pihi jonin ta jotsistonen hea jamaquihqui hihqui jaa huisha joi.
Janoxihquibo jaríyamahi bi tah hen mato rahmabi yohihi, jaressca jaiboya man hea hen qui man honannon.
Hen mato yohinon nincanahue: hean raanah cahax nocotaiton mato johue hahcaibaan ta hea rihbi johue hahquiqui. Johue hea jaibaan ta hea raanni rihbi johue hahquiqui.
Judasen bihmanoxihqui Jesusen yohihi
Jato jascajaquin yohixon masa shinanxon jato yohicoinquin: —Man honannon hihxon tah hen mato yohihi: mato tocan tsahotai huestichin ta hea paranxon bihmanoxihquiqui —jato jaquin.
Jahuen haxenicabo bejisahtanani. —¿Tsoa yohihiquin? —shinancanquin.
Hahan Jesus queenai jahuen haxenica cahen Jesus senenbi tsahoti.
Simon Pedron sca jaa cohan cohan hihxon: —¿Tsoa yohihiquin? Yocahue —hahquin.
Jesus senenbixon yocascaquin: —¿Tsoa hin, Hihbon?
—Nea paan tequen netinxon hen hinanai joni tah qui —hahquin Jesusen. Jascaxon paaman netinxon Judas hinanquin. Simon Iscariotenin baque can, Judas.
Paan teque bichiton jahuen jointi Satanasnen hihbojaquin. —Hoa min hahcatsihqui hahtanhue, Judasen, histon —hahquin Jesusen.
Jahua yohiquin jascahiquin misa janin tsahotaibaan honanyamaquin.
—Noquen coriqui coiranai copi rah ta hahan fiestajati piti non pishinai marotanhue hahquiqui —shinanquin caibaan. —Jahuaborajomabo coriqui hinantanhue hah ra ta jaiqui —shinanquin caibaan rihbi.
Hahtanhue hahca jahuen paan bichish Judas caresscai, yamescai bi.
Behna joi
Caresscaiya Jesusen jato yohiquin: —Hea noquebaque nete hihbo hihqui ta rahma jisnoxihcanihqui. Jisquin ta noquen Papa rihbi nete hihbo hihqui jiscantihiqui.
Hea jisxon Papa Dios nete hihbo hi honanaiboya ta nete hihbo hihxon jato jismatihiqui, jahuen baque rihbi nete hihbo hi honanahbo. Rahmabi ta jascajatihiqui.
Basima bi res tah hen mato betan hihtihi, heen baquebaan. Man tah man hea benayaxihqui. Hen judiobo yohihipi quescajaquin ta hen mato rahma yohihi. Hea jano cahiton tah man cati hahtipahtimahi.
Joi behna ta hen mato yohihi. Nincanahue. Joni huetsahon shinannahue, hean hen matohon shinanai quescajaquin. Joni huetsahon shinannahue.
Man joni huetsahon shinanaiya ta heen haxenicabo mato qui jatihixonbi honancantihiqui —jato jaquin.
Jesus qui Pedro paramehxihqui
—¿Jahuerahnon min canoxihquin, Hihbon? —hahquin Simon Pedronen. —Hen jano cahiton tah min rahma chibantimahi. Huetsa tian tah min hehchon catihi —Jesusen jaquin.
Pedronen yocaquin: —¿Jahua copi hen mia rahmabi chibanti hahtipahyamahin? Hea rehtecatsihquibo que bi tah hen mia jenetimahi —hahquin.
—¿Mia rehtecatsihquibo que bi min hea jenetimahin? Nincahue, hen mia yohinon: hatapa queorih jaima bi tah min quimisha coti heen joni hihtima min yohinoxihqui.
